name: Unmaker, Antithesis
body:
UNMAKER, ANTITHESIS
CR 25/MR 8

XP 1,228,800
CE Colossal outsider (native, psionic, unmaker)
Init +12/–8M, dual initiative MA; Senses all-around vision, aura sight, darkvision 120 ft., lifeseeker 105 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +41; Aura phrenic overload (100 ft., DC 32), plane-rending aura (300 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 43, touch 14, flat-footed 43 (+12 deflection, +29 natural, –8 size)
hp 499 (27d10+373); regeneration 20
Fort +28, Ref +9, Will +26; second save MA
Defensive Abilities all-around vision, ruinous shield; insulated resolve; DR 20/epic; Immune cold; PR 40
Weaknesses unstable resolve

OFFENSE

Speed 90 ft., fly 180 ft. (perfect)
Melee 7 slams +36 (4d10+25/19–20 plus 1d6 Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma drain plus cosmic isolation)
Space 60 ft.; Reach 60 ft.
Special Attacks cosmic isolation (DC 35), mythic power (8/day, surge +1d10), powerful blows (slam), psionic fist +2, ravage the masses
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 24th; concentration +36)

Constant—aura sight, deathless form (immune to death from ability drain and death effects), energy adaptation, lifeseeker (grants line of effect, applies to undead), phrenic overload (DC 34, penalty to AC and DCs, confuses, automatically read minds), pierce the veils, reddopsi, slip the bonds
At will—alienation (DC 34, 8 targets), dispel psionics*, divert teleportM (DC), energy current (24d6–24 force, DC 30), extradimensional waymaking*, horrid transformation (DC 29, may affect corporeal creatures), interplanetary psychoportM, memory modification (DC 26), mental contagion* (DC 28), mental evolution* (DC 34), planar travel, psychosis (DC 34, 6 targets), sensory cascade (DC 26, permanent), sever the strandM, shatter mind blank* (DC 27), tactical suppression* (DC 34), telekinetic force (625 lbs, DC 34), telekinetic maneuver (+6), wrench
3/day—crisis of lifeM (22 HD, DC 34), feed to oblivion* (DC 31, 2 targets), inverse possession* (DC 26), mind control* (DC 32), mind seed (DC 30), psionic effigy*, soul stealing (240 damage, DC 34), quickened mental contagion* (DC 28), spacial displacement*, trigger power
1/day—apopsiM (DC 31), reality revisionM, unravel psionics (DC 31), violate identity* (DC 34) (powers do not include the +2 DC bonus from Greater Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str 44, Dex 11, Con 36, Int 31, Wis 32, Cha 35
Base Atk +27; CMB +50; CMD 72
Feats Deep Focus, Flyby Attack, Greater Power Penetration, Greater Psionic Endowment, Greater Psionic Fist, Improved Critical (slam), Improved InitiativeM, Metapsionic Ability (mental contagion, Quicken Power ), Mythic Psionic AttacksM, Power Attack, Power Penetration, Psionic Body, Psionic EndowmentM, Psionic Fist, Unavoidable StrikeM, Void Focus
Skills Bluff +42, Diplomacy +39, Fly +28, Intimidate +42, Knowledge (arcana) +37, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +37, Knowledge (geography) +37, Knowledge (local) +37, Knowledge (nature) +37, Knowledge (planes) +40, Knowledge (psionics) +40, Knowledge (religion) +37, Perception +41, Sense Motive +38, Spellcraft +40, Survival +38
Languages telepathy 300 ft, .truespeech
SQ no breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cosmic Isolation (Su)

A creature damaged by the antithesis’ slam attack must succeed at a DC 35 Will save or become disconnected from any patrons or otherworldly forces which grant them powers. For the next 24 hours, the target is treated as if they have temporarily broken their codes of conduct. Any character affected by cosmic isolation who has a class that is restricted to a specific alignment is treated as an ex-member of that class for 24 hours; an atonement spell or similar ability can end this effect. Other effects which are dependent on an otherworldly patron or connection to other planes may be suppressed at GM discretion.

Insulated Resolve (Ex)

The Diplomacy DC to make an antithesis suppress its regeneration and void shield is equal to 30 + its Hit Dice (normally 57). For any saving throw against an effect which could be used to cure or suppress compulsion, confusion, emotion, or insanity effect, the antithesis rolls twice and takes the higher result. By spending a point of mythic power, the antithesis may automatically succeed at such a saving throw against such an effect if it is from a non-mythic source.

Massive (Ex)

Because of antithesis’s size, uneven ground and other terrain features that form difficult terrain generally pose no significant hindrance to its movement, though forests or settlements are considered difficult terrain. A Huge or smaller creature can move through any square the antithesis occupies, and vice versa. The antithesis can make attacks of opportunity only against foes that are Huge or larger, and can be flanked only by Huge or larger foes.

The antithesis gains a bonus for being on higher ground only if its entire space is on higher ground than that of its target. It is possible for a Huge or smaller creature to climb the antithesis with a successful DC 30 Climb check, however unlike the normal rules regarding the antithesis and attacks of opportunity, a Small or larger creature that climbs on the antithesis provokes an attack of opportunity from the monster.

Plane-Rending Aura (Su)

Creatures and objects within 300 feet of an antithesis are prevented from traveling through planes as per the dimensional lock spell and are made corporeal as per the rending the veil power with no saving throw for as long as they remain within this aura (this does not cause incorporeal creatures to become dazed. Any creature which dies in the antithesis’ plane-rending aura is affected as the sever the strand power.

Any extradimensional space within the antithesis’ plane-rending aura implodes, scattering its contents in the nearest available square. If the space is in the possession of a creature, the owner is allowed a DC 35 Will saving throw to stop the implosion. Any extraplanar creature which starts its turn within the plane-rending aura or attempts to move into the aura must succeed at a DC 35 Will saving throw or be banished as per expulsion.

The save DC is Charisma-based. A creature which successfully saves against the antithesis’ plane-rending aura is immune to its banishing effect for 24 hours.

Ravage the Masses (Su)

Whenever an antithesis uses a psi-like ability which targets one or more creatures rather than an area, the antithesis may choose to target any number of creatures within 300 feet that it can perceive.

By spending a point of mythic power, the antithesis can extend this range from 300 feet to 10 miles.

ABOUT

With their gnarled branchlike limbs and overwhelming psionic presence, the titanic antitheses first lays waste to supernatural structures, then to otherworldly intercessors, and finally to the minds of the masses as it strips from them any hopes of agency. Unleashing a single antithesis can cause great strain for a Consumption manifestation, potentially allowing the greater hivemind to be destroyed should this mythic avatar fall.
